taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-01 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 332.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 601.3 | 6.89 | 7.41
3 | 359.9 | 16.01 | 23.42
4 | 286.0 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-01
Curve type: KQ-type
Aquifer depth: 7.41 – 23.42 m (extending into basement layer below 23.42 m)
Recommendation: Drill to a recommended depth of 35–40 m to fully penetrate the saturated weathered/fractured zone identified below 7.41 m. Case off the top 7.4 m of resistive overburden and place well screens within the lower resistivity zones from 8 m downward.
